info.text: Isaac takes damage at the start of each new floor
Grants 1-5 coins when defeating a boss
At least 1 lucky penny is guaranteed to appear
Break rocks by walking over them
Tears are replaced with bubbles which fire in unpredictable directions
Heals half a red heart on room clear
Small chance to grant half a soul heart instead
Randomly reveals rooms on the map
Grants a luck based chance to upgrade the quality of spawned items
Every item spawned in the future will be taken from the current room's item pool
Keys have a chance to drop Cracked Keys when collected
